findings.finding: Five existing construction-related candidates still lack canonical admission.
findings.remediation: Obtain the applicable exact owner disposition and select contract compatibility. An agent audit, local fixture signature or Git commit is not that disposition.

findings.finding: Full construction-chain gate is specified but not executed by the current Define builder.
findings.remediation: Implement the existing gate as a selected source-bound workflow before conformant generation, including handoff freshness, design coverage, capabilities and independent output conformance. Keep the generic compiler generic.

findings.finding: No continuous Define workflow joins portable packages to artifact-type/record drafts, review dispositions, authorization, native commit and canonical publication.
findings.remediation: Compose existing capabilities with persistent exact correlation and recovery. CandidatePreparation/ReviewRequest and shared CandidateAdmission exist, but CLI prepare does not run a production review queue or admission coordinator.

findings.finding: Product Workspace reads work, but Define sessions/drafts have Project-centric scope and no Product placement.
findings.remediation: Define Product-wide no-Project preparation explicitly and preserve native Project membership for effects that require it; onboard real selected Project/store bindings instead of inventing migration Projects.

findings.finding: Shared draft CLI executes Python native creation logic rather than the compiled creation operations; the generated admission stage remains a qualification fixture adapter.
findings.remediation: Route shared draft decisions through the existing AlchLang operations and add a custody/authenticated production host adapter for the existing native writer. Do not recreate the removed Python Define engine or duplicate the Lab runtime.

findings.finding: Definition/v2 candidate materialization is not a canonical registry publication path; registry still declares Definition/v1.
findings.remediation: Select an explicit compatible carrier/registry transition, authorize exact deterministic postimages, publish indexes/projections/drift/state, and move the source cut explicitly. Preserve admitted historical v1 bytes.

findings.finding: Integrated Definition/record lifecycle helpers only create new admissions.
findings.remediation: Reuse existing native revision/withdrawal checks and add predecessor-bound authoring, dependent type/record/ontology/consumer impact and explicit store/source transition helpers.

findings.finding: The older full-chain resource projection has five references to removed Python/connector sources; migration completion flags are narrower than workflow completion.
findings.remediation: Create a reviewed successor projection referencing current AlchLang roles and current tests. Preserve original frozen review evidence; separate routing/candidate proof from production write and full-chain conformance claims.
